title: The Lid on the Tin
lines: Kim and Sid have a tin of six nuts.
The lid is on. Kim tugs at it.
She tugs and tugs, but the lid sits.
Kim gets a rag and rubs the tin.
She tugs. Pop! The lid is up!
"Six nuts!" said Sid, and he hops up.
Kim and Sid sit and have six nuts.

questions.listenFor: Six nuts. The first line says it. If your child is stuck, point at that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: What did Kim do to get the lid off?
questions.listenFor: She rubbed the wet tin dry with a rag, then tugged. Lines four and five carry it. This is the cause and effect to talk about.

questions.ask: The rag made the tin dry. What else could Kim have used to grip the lid?
questions.listenFor: Any idea — a cloth, a towel, dry hands. Lines four and five are where the wet tin gets rubbed.
